limitations.text: H1 was not evaluated confirmatorily under the frozen preoutcome authority because no prefrozen FORMAL uncalibrated arm was available. Later RAW-vs-CAL numerical results are non-confirmatory evidence.

No ground-truth critical events were observed among 24917 valid critical labels. H2 and H4 are not evaluable and H3 reliability is not evaluable. Zero observed events must not be interpreted as zero risk.
C3 modeled safety conclusions are sensitive to the frozen FAST/NOMINAL/SLOW human-response profile.
Under/over-confidence calibration robustness is not evaluable because no prefrozen numeric perturbation rule existed.
The 17 requested failure-case slices could not be evaluated without inventing post-FORMAL membership rules; therefore only a fail-closed authority audit is reported.

C2 has no recorded FORMAL solver timing; C3 has preoutcome action-materialization component runtimes but no validated FORMAL system/end-to-end timing carrier. Low-latency, real-time, and speedup claims are not supported.
Twenty-two scenes required documented physical future-GT rereads. The full 26,209-scene cohort remains primary; the exact 22-scene exclusion is a mandatory secondary sensitivity.

No untouched locally evaluable DeepSense split remains for a new independent Stage-9 confirmation. DeepSense evidence is limited to communication-policy support and does not validate optical/headlamp, glare, collision, or C3 safety claims.
C3 is a human-factors-informed modeled safety extension, not evidence of population-level crash reduction or a universal glare-recovery time.

No current sealed aggregate reaction-margin distribution was materialized. The frozen H5 P(C_late)-based pairwise comparisons remain reportable, but no post-FORMAL reaction-margin distribution is constructed.

The server contains a historical joint-absolute Block-9.7 branch. The C2 formulation executed in the 9.13A -> R4 -> FORMAL chain is the conditional 99% critical-coverage constraint missed<=floor(C/100); manuscript equations must follow the executed chain.
